content.text: {"id": "mm6840e2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among the 1,249 measles cases reported in 2019, 1,163 (93%) were associated with the 22 outbreaks"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of unvaccinated patients and patients with unknown vaccination status was similar in NYC (89%), NYS (91%), and other U.S. (87%) outbreaks."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "1,107 (89%) were in patients who were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination status"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 119 (10%) patients were hospitalized"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "New York State (309; excludes New York City), New York City (605; excludes New York State)"}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "and shorter durations (median = 27 days; range = 5–82 days)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 119 (10%) patients were hospitalized"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "were of smaller sizes (median = six cases; range = 3–79 cases)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "was similar in NYC (89%), NYS (91%), and other U.S. (87%) outbreaks"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among the 1,487 cases reported to CDC during September 30, 2018–October 1, 2019"}]}, {"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2019, 22 outbreaks occurred in 17 states (seven were multistate outbreaks)"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Cases are classified according to the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists’ case definition for measles"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Received ≥1 dose of measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types", "study_design"]}
